study_identification_part.si_4_title: Mapping Neurophysiological Subtypes of Major Depressive Disorder Using Normative Models of the Functional Connectome

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: DIDA-MDD (Disease Imaging Data Archiving - Major Depressive Disorder Working Group) multisite dataset from 9 research centers.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "...from 9 research centers from the DIDA-MDD (Disease Imaging Data Archiving - Major Depressive Disorder Working Group)..."

answer.DIDA-MDD: Healthy controls used to estimate normative models (10-fold cross-validation and final training on all HCs); patients with MDD used for deviation mapping and subtyping analyses.

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Normative modeling in HCs with 10-fold cross-validation; final models trained on all HCs; patient deviations derived from the normative model.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "...including 1148 patients with MDD and 1079 matched HCs from 9 research centers from the DIDA-MDD..."; "...we estimated a normative model of FCS as a function of age and sex... in the HCs..."; "...we first estimated the normative models in the HCs under 10-fold cross-validation... Then, the final normative models were trained on all HCs for the subsequent MDD deviation analyses."
